description: The Cutest Halloween Sugar Cookies!👻🍪 - 1 cup butter, softened  - 1 cup white sugar  - 1 large egg  - 1 tbsp almond extract - 1 tbsp vanilla extract  - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp baking powder  - 2 3/4 cups flour  There’s only 59 days until Halloween! Who’s excited?!  These Halloween Sugar Cookies are the perfect festive treat. They’re an easy, no spread cut out sugar cookie dough that are so delicious!  Decorate pumpkins, ghosts, bats and skulls, or cut out circles to decorate as mummies and Frankenstein’s monster!  Happy spooky season!🎃 #halloweensugarcookies #halloweencookies #halloweendesserts #halloweentreats #sugarcookierecipe
